scope: Sender-owned acknowledged exact repeats only. Nonrepeat selector and existing object protocol remain unchanged.
diagnosis: WarmSession previously always entered warm selection. A repeat traversed delta preparation/scoring and hashed the target despite owning immutable acknowledged bytes and their verified ID.
change: Compare complete new bytes and length with the scoped ready acknowledged base; reuse its ID through a private acknowledged-base-typed client helper. Send Raw Begin alone, require current Published, and continue the same Raw offer on Ready after eviction.

initial_environment_failure.cause: PATH cargo resolved to unrelated cargo-ai. This is not counted as a behavioral RED. Subsequent commands explicitly use rustup Cargo.

behavioral_red.reason: Exact repeat prepared three frames where the new contract requires one Raw Begin.

assertions: Raw Begin only and no Data on exact cache hit
238-byte existing HTTP-body framing for the exact-repeat probe
Current object-ID and sequence validation; missing/lost acknowledgement cannot complete
Evicted target continues the same Raw offer/transfer and exact bytes survive stopped-store reopen
Scope/epoch mismatch is rejected before any exchange
Existing localized-change path still uses 600 HTTP-body bytes
validation.independent_review: Pending separate reviewer; this receipt is implementation validation, not independent approval.

diagnostic.measurement: Native sender preparation plus test-generated current acknowledgement; exact input ownership clone is outside both timed intervals. Real endpoint seeding occurs before measurement.
diagnostic.samples: One warmup retained but excluded from medians, then three measured repeats at each size and version.
diagnostic.context: Actual MVM timing windows were excluded. The after diagnostic ran during unrelated UOR lab compilation activity. No other lab was stopped or modified. This is not a controlled release-build performance acceptance experiment.
diagnostic.interpretation: The measured native diagnostic supports eliminating repeated preparation/hashing. It does not establish a MVM, WAN, cryptographic, whole-endpoint CPU or energy speedup; those require the separate frozen-binary campaign.
